classification.difficultyReason: Identify and name the unmarked pair of alternate interior angles.

content.prompt: The marked angles are alternate angles: they lie inside the two lines and on opposite sides of the transversal $PQ$. There is a second pair of alternate angles in the diagram. Can you name the angles of this pair?

spec.description: AB rises gently to the right; CD rises slightly to the right. QP descends through E on AB and F on CD. Single arc at AEF and double arc at EFD; no parallel marks.
spec.mathematics: The unmarked alternate interior pair is BEF and CFE. Identification depends on interior position and opposite sides of the transversal, without assuming parallel lines.
spec.answerVisibility: All vertices, lines and original angle arcs are permanent givens. The requested pair is named only in answers.

answer.worked: $\angle BEF$ and $\angle CFE$ lie between $AB$ and $CD$, on opposite sides of the transversal $PQ$, so they form the second pair of alternate angles.
